evidence.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Node.js ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Type check
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Verify package contents
        if: matrix.node == 22
        run: pnpm pack --pack-destination /tmp

# Tydora 的 DSH 组合包补丁层。
# 被 package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch 引用；用户执行 `dsh plugin add` 时应用此层。
# name 指向仓库内的插件入口（相对本文件）。
- insert:
    - id: tydora
      name: './dsh/index.ts'

animeWindowsSourcePatch.reason: Replace POSIX mkdir/cp with portable Node filesystem operations while preserving tsc and copied artifacts.

replacements.from: "tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p lib/tests/fixtures && cp src/client.js lib/client.js && cp node_modules/hls.js/dist/hls.min.js lib/hls.min.js && cp src/tests/fixtures/* lib/tests/fixtures/"

followup.preferredCandidateApproach: Use direct buildCommands in recommendations.json to avoid pnpm run automatic-install behavior; source patch alone fixes only POSIX command portability.
